brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full at level 0 with piece:0,0,1;full at level 1 stacked via snap:0,0,0;full, plus side bases at level 1 (piece:1,0,1;half-w) creating second-storey footprint. Build spans 80mm per level, covers at y=160mm (cover:0,0,1;full;top and cover:1,0,1;half-w;top) form upper deck.

requirements.requirement: Storage tower suitable for a workbench (compact vertical storage with flat top)
requirements.evidence: Vertical tower footprint ~2 hex cells, capped open faces and joint bolts locked. Top covers provide flat work surface (f2, f3, f31 deck). Dressed with workbench props: tape on cover:0,0,1;full;top (prop:1), multimeter on deck (prop:5) visible from above.

Three notch drawer frames installed: notch:0#-1,1#notch1 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm) at -1,1 level0, notch:0#0,-1#notch4 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf) at 0,-1 level0, and notch:1#0,1#notch1 at 0,1 level1. Each occupies an empty cell between touching bases, with compartments filled (hexkey-set, heap-screws-bin, heap-nuts-bin).

finish.summary: Built a compact two-storey tower (full base at 0,0 on level 0 and level 1, with side half-bases) providing three notch drawers - two on level 0 and one on level 1 - exceeding the two-drawer minimum. Open faces capped and joints locked, top covers create a flat deck for workbench use, dressed with workshop tools to show purpose. Checked: meshClash clear, no prop warnings.

M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
